name: make a QDP ascii table parser accept lowercase command and header lines
definition: Relax command/line-type recognition in the QDP reader so keywords and status markers are matched case-insensitively.
failure_mode: Lowercase command lines still raise an unrecognized-line error

name: map each listed paper to its author-maintained official code repository
definition: Parse the paper subject document to enumerate papers and identify each one's official repository owned by the authors/org.
failure_mode: Wrong repository or mismatched id/URL fails per-line comparison.
